summary: News read (2026-11-27): Intensifying AI fears, U.S. curbs on Nvidia's China chip access, and an S&P warning of a potential credit rating cut on Nvidia over governance risks are pressuring technology shares and U.S. stocks, even as some tech names bounced off their lows and Asian tech rebounded. Meanwhile, a 3.8% October reading on the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, expectations of a December rate hike, new U.S. tariffs including on China, and record U.S. oil production weigh on consumers and energy, while surging October new home sales and utility data center deals provide isolated bright spots.
